verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Investing for the Future; Watercom activities

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, and K4 are adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 is covered in S1, S2, and S4 (revenue growth, operating profit, net profit). K2 is covered in S2 and S3 (private customer revenue increase, business customer revenue decrease due to tariff harmonization). K3 is covered in S6 (electricity expense reduction due to new combined heat and power plant). K4 is covered in S8 and S9 (smart water meter rollout, pipe rehabilitation, trenchless methods). However, K5 (drinking water quality compliance, Green Company award, environmental initiatives, climate targets), K6 (liquidity position, loan details), K7 (dividend policy and payout), and K8 (2026 strategic priorities) are entirely missing from the candidate summary. The summary captures the main financial performance and some operational highlights but omits several HIGH-importance items (K5) and all MEDIUM-importance items (K6, K7), as well as HIGH-importance strategic priorities (K8). This results in substantial gaps in the overall coverage.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected and support the overall narrative of financial growth and strategic investments. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetition. Each sentence builds upon the previous ones, providing a clear progression of financial performance, cost dynamics, strategic investments, operational improvements, and regulatory management. The summary forms a cohesive whole without any material internal contradictions or logical flaws.
